notes: 10 clubs, each plays the other four times (twice home, twice away): 36 matches per club, 180 in total; season 15 Aug 2026 - May 2027. Single row, so closed both ways; the First League of Kosovo (level 2) is outside our data. Movement: 10th and 9th relegated directly, 8th plays a relegation play-off; the First League is played in two groups (A and B), each group's champion is promoted, and the two group runners-up play a semi-final whose winner meets the Superleague 8th. So the normal reading is 2 direct up + 1 play-off place, and 2 direct down + 1 play-off place on the top-flight side. The 2025-26 play-off confirms the pairing: Dinamo Ferizaj beat Liria Prizren in the semi-final and then played Llapi (8th in the Superleague) for the last place.
